title: Protect first changed-window admissions while retaining broadband foreground learning
description: Conditional guarded evaluation2400-2409 removes stationary-to-slow background admissions(10control/5positive->0/0), but three stationary-to-fast positive admissions occur in the very first changed window60, before2/3 uncertainty evidence exists. Guarded stationary identity falls46.5->44.9%, with two high_rustle classes never admitted. Investigate provisional/ delayed commitment for abrupt first-window uncertainty, and protect broadband learning; do not simply turn unconditional corroboration back on, since development v1 lost23.5pp stationary recall.
acceptance_criteria: New frozen evaluation after development; distinguish first-window, settled and rare spectral errors; quantify background admission reduction alongside class coverage, first novel attention, matched and censored delays, established memory retention and per-class broadband recall. Keep actor decisions waveform-only and source-deletion controls.

title: Prevent transition-time background admissions before gain selection settles
description: Frozen adaptive evaluation2200-2209 improves stationary-to-fast localized repeat identity9.8->39.2% and preserves stationary50.1%, but stationary-to-slow still admits7 background prototypes in pure controls and3 in positive streams before the mode switch. Modes need6-26 windows to react to slow changes. Stationary-to-fast positive streams admit4 background prototypes. Preserving all admitted vectors keeps these contaminants. Investigate admission quarantine or uncertainty handling without erasing established foreground IDs or treating every target as a background change.
acceptance_criteria: Explain admission timing relative to suspected changes and switches; compare a conservative transition-admission rule on a new frozen split against fixed/current adaptive policies; retain detection/identity/deletion measures and stationary target learning; preserve established IDs; quantify recurrence delay and true one-off novelty losses.
notes: Implementation: additive new-admission hook defaults true for existing actors; guarded actor preserves sensory features and established recognition, corroborates candidates with memory-free compensated evidence. Unconditional v1 development2200-2201 eliminates two slow-control admissions but stationary identity48.7->25.2%; snapshot retained. Conditional v2 activates guard after2/3 high CV windows in raw mode and releases after3 low windows or compensation. V2 development and one-off fixtures running; fresh evaluation reserved2400-2409.
close_reason: Completed two development variants plus frozen2400-2409 comparison:120k main and28.8k one-off decisions, audited source/SNR/matrix/paired/cohort/delay/probe results. Conditional guard removes slow-control10->0 and mixed5->0 admissions, costs1.6pp stationary recall and loses2/60 stationary classes. Residual first-window and spectral errors tracked .2.2.4/.2.4; paper06/docs updated,98 tests pass.

title: Test hysteretic waveform-only gain-mode adaptation against transition benchmark
description: Transition development seeds 1900-1901 confirm frozen startup selection remains raw after stationary-to-fast modulation and silent startup, with 100% later no-target attention, while always-compensated stationary identity is lower. Develop a stable history-based waveform-only selector rather than per-window CV switching, since foreground bursts can raise CV. Preserve admitted IDs, define background/pending reset semantics and quantify adaptation latency and transient false memories.
acceptance_criteria: Tune only on declared development seeds; new untouched evaluation seeds after policy freeze. Compare fixed/raw/always-compensated on matched transitions, quantify stationary retention, source-deletion identity, mode switches from isolated foregrounds and false admissions. Do not use labels/stems to decide mode.
close_reason: Evaluated unchanged 7/9 hysteretic selector on fresh2200-2209: 96,000 decisions, source/hash/matrix/phase/bootstrap/adaptation audits pass, paper06 updated,86 tests/grader1.0. Stationary-fast identity9.8->39.2%, stationary50.1 unchanged. Residual pre-switch background admissions explicitly tracked sibling .3; method remains experimental.

title: Build and audit matched changing-background experiment
description: Measure stationary/modulated transitions, silent startup, shallower modulation and spectral changes with paired foreground/no-target streams. Freeze development/evaluation seeds and source snapshots; report phase-specific localized identity, false attention/admissions and same-state source-deletion controls before deciding whether an adaptive policy helps.
acceptance_criteria: Reproducible runner, seeded continuous scenes, component/SNR checks, independently recomputable summaries, paper update and follow-ups for uncovered failure modes.
close_reason: Completed matched changing-background benchmark: 14,400 development and 72,000 fresh evaluation decisions, full hash/matrix/schedule/SNR/phase/bootstrap audits, paper06 and reproduction guide. Adaptive policy is tracked separately in sibling .2.

title: Adapt compensation safely when the environment changes after calibration
description: Silent-profile numerical recovery is now fixed, but calibrated-gain still freezes a raw/compensated choice from the first three windows. Silent/stationary startup followed by modulation can remain raw, and modulation followed by quiet conditions can retain a recall-costly transform. Build matched positive/negative transitions, slow/shallower rates and spectral changes; investigate a waveform-only stable update policy without treating foreground bursts as an environment switch.
acceptance_criteria: New development/frozen evaluation split; preserve admitted IDs while defining pending/background reset semantics; no condition labels or stems enter decisions; stationary retention, false attention/admission and source-deletion identity metrics; contaminated startup and realistic source overlap included or explicitly tracked as independent follow-ups.
notes:
Benchmark child .1 completed. Fresh seeds2000-2009 show frozen mode false attention100% after stationary/silent-to-fast; source-deletion identity11.2% vs localized identity11.4% in stationary-fast. Always compensation stationary identity28.5% vs raw42.2%. Persistent-evidence selector in sibling .2 implemented; fresh adaptive evaluation2200-2209 running. Forced contaminated startup/overlap tracked ch-6w4.10.4.2.3.
Adaptive child .2 completed with96k fresh decisions and paper06. Keeps stationary50.1%, improves stationary-fast identity39.2 vs9.8 and attention11.7 vs100%. Does NOT solve safe admission:7 background prototypes in7/10 slow-transition controls,3 positive slow,4 positive fast, all pre-switch. Parent stays in_progress with open child .3 admission uncertainty/quarantine. New contamination/overlap issue at broader parent .2.3.
Child .3 experimental admission guard evaluated/frozen on2400-2409:slow no-target controls10->0/mixed5->0, stationary46.5->44.9 with2 class/seed memories lost, one-off novel attention unchangedstationary/improves5/60 in slow changes. Firstchangedwindow3mixed admissions remain(.4 open), plus broader spectralissue .2.4 and candidate-birth provenance .10.7. Keep parent in_progress. Paper06 documents all limits.

title: Recover spectral-gain calibration after silent startup
description: Verified fixture seed1700: after three exact-silence windows, fixed spectral gain detects11 later foreground windows versus quiet-band30. Its profile freezes at the numerical floor during silence. Fit the gain template only from usable-energy windows, provide a raw-power fallback while unavailable, and safely rebase late gain calibration without deleting admitted prototypes. Preserve normal-calibration and calibrated raw-path behavior.
acceptance_criteria: Silent-to-audible fixture recovers ordinary spectral-gain behavior; no near-zero template lock; finite outputs; ordinary calibration remains equivalent; late calibration suppresses admissions appropriately and retains admitted IDs/vectors; calibrated raw mode still matches baseline; documented reset/limits and tests.
close_reason: Gain template now waits for usable band energy, raw-falls back while unavailable, and rebases late background/pending state without deleting admitted prototypes. Archived/current 10-seed regression: old silent81/372 detections versus clean197/372; corrected silent exactlymatches clean, including runtime feature/salience checks. 4800 stored decisions/source hashes independently audited. Raw calibrated path and load-memory retention tests pass; full78 tests, grader1.0. Documentation updated; broader changing-environment follow-up filed.

title: Evaluate pitch-tolerant identity matching with calibrated masking and source-deletion controls
description: Channel study at matched -6dB post-residual SNR: calibrated-gain localized repeat recognition drops from34.2% reference to17.3% pitch-only,26.6% duration-only,18.8% combined. Current-source-deleted probes have near-zero attention/identity for this frontend, so remaining identity errors merit targeted study. Compare bounded frequency alignment or multiple exemplars against fixed cosine matching; simply broadening radius previously merged classes. Library transform artifacts and factory-label ambiguity remain limits.
acceptance_criteria: Develop on observed1600-series evidence then evaluate fresh seeds; separate detection/confirmation/identity errors; retain false-admission/deletion controls and calibrated SNR; report cross-class confusion and class-duration effects; no oracle pitch/transform parameters in learner; compare recorded source variants when available.

title: Test spectral-gain calibration failure modes and changing spectra
description: Spectral-gain uses a three-window warmup-only band template. Current study excludes silent or foreground-contaminated calibration, spectral transitions, overlapping sources and enlarged source transformations. Test those cases independently, including near-zero template energies and safe recalibration; preserve admitted-memory semantics and waveform-only decisions. The silence/template-floor interaction is a specific numerical concern, not yet a field result.
acceptance_criteria: Silent-to-audible and contaminated-start fixtures; finite stable gain with no permanent blind state; matched positive/negative transition controls; source overlap/pitch-duration stress cases; fresh frozen evaluation and explicit state reset policy; no retuning on seeds 1200-1209.
notes:
Calibration-derived choice now preserves stationary identity on fresh seeds1400-1409 and retains modulation recovery, but freezes a mode after three representative background windows. Add slower/shallower modulation and mid-run amplitude/spectrum changes to this task, plus silence/foreground-contaminated calibration. It can wrongly remain in raw mode if silent startup precedes a later modulated environment. Fixed spectral template floor under silent startup remains a numerical concern. Do not tune on seeds1200-1209 or1400-1409.
Completed ch-6w4.9 now supplies opt-in continuously filtered source/background stems, current-source removal retaining all prior echoes, post-residual SNR matching, and independent pitch/time operations. Use those tools for honest overlap and source-variation controls; avoid scaling a composite foreground+masker as though its total energy were foreground-only SNR. Fresh1600-series data include a halfway fan/level change but do not settle targeted startup or overlap generalization.

title: Recover stationary recall while preserving spectral-gain background rejection
description: Fresh gain evaluation seeds 1200-1209: fixed spectral-gain recovers fast localized repeat identity (55.1% vs quiet-band 1.2%) and rejects background prototypes, but stationary identity falls from 67.3% to 45.5%. Investigate per-class gate/features losses and selective/adaptive compensation or evidence fusion. Do not choose solely by averaged recall or reintroduce slow/fast background attention.
acceptance_criteria: Develop on observed cases then freeze fresh split; report stationary non-regression and modulated recall separately; preserve nuisance/attention controls and matched-overlap diagnostics; identify class-level misses, no oracle switching based on condition labels; recorded positives when available.
close_reason: Implemented waveform-only calibration-derived compensation selection, fixed after three windows, with distinct persisted schema and opt-in replay. Fresh 43200-decision evaluation: stationary identity exactly69.3% same asquiet-band, slow46.2% vs22.2%, fast48.8% vs5.2%; no background prototypes in controls, fast attention0.2%. Calibration, source, timing, pairing, uncertainty and overlap-control audits pass. Paper04/docs updated; 60 tests, grader1.0. Broader startup/transitions remain sibling .2 and parent remains open.

title: Compare event-region overlap with matched background and shifted-interval nulls
description: Localization task adds IoU but fast modulation still yields 83.9% quiet-band overlap at IoU 0.25 while pure ambience attention is 97.5% and localized correct identity only 2.9%. Broad background regions can coincide with sources by chance. Add interval-length-preserving temporal nulls and matched ambience-region versus foreground-interval controls, reporting excess overlap with seed-paired uncertainty. Keep method selection separate from diagnostic scoring.
acceptance_criteria: Counterfactual/shift definitions and boundary handling explicit; nulls preserve interval lengths; no truth enters learner; source/no-source comparisons paired by seed and time; sensitivity to IoU and class duration; report excess overlap and identity rather than raw recall alone; update paper and track remaining causal limits.
close_reason: Added matched-background and length-preserving legal-position controls, paired seed uncertainty and class-duration sensitivity on audited localization evidence. Source/input hashes and analysis archived; whole-window cancellation fixtures pass. Paper 03 and guide updated. 50 tests and grader 1.0 pass. Stronger identical-state probe work added to ch-6w4.9 and control metrics added to ch-6w4.10.4.

title: Develop modulation-robust noise estimation without losing masked foregrounds
description: Controlled study ch-6w4.10.2 separates spectrum/channel from modulation. Quiet-band learns ambience in every slow-modulation control, none in stationary or fast controls. Existing binwise estimator rejects slow controls but costs roughly 25 pp detection in varied-spectrum/channel foregrounds and loses stationary recall. Compare causal time-varying noise estimates, shared-quiet/binwise combinations or principled MCRA/PCEN baselines with localization-aware scoring. Do not choose solely by false prototype count. Development seeds 800-802 and evaluation 900-909 are now observed evidence.
acceptance_criteria: New sealed evaluation after development, fixed memory matching, affected-stream and false-alarm metrics, temporal event overlap plus recall, stationary/slow/fast controls, source-disjoint recordings when available; update source snapshots and paper.
notes:
Localization controls now available in papers/results/masked-events/localization-controls and paper 03: fast quiet-band raw IoU>=0.25 is 83.9%, matched background 72.0%, alternative placements 77.2%. Require excess-over-control metrics plus localized identity and affected-stream/attention metrics; do not optimize raw overlap alone.
25 Oct current iteration: initial RMS times .05/.2/.5 fail fast attention; .005/.01/.02 reject controls but lose foreground. Third development stage adds fixed .02 s median-band shared-gain against a warmup-only spectral template: 49.7% mean localized repeat recognition across the three development cells, zero ambience attention/admissions, but stationary recall below quiet-band. Selection and all failed stages archived; seeds 1200-1209 now evaluating all ten frozen methods. No default replacement planned.
Controlled shared-gain milestone is complete and documented in paper04: 72000 fresh evaluation decisions audited, 58 tests and original grader 1.0 pass; experimental replay is opt-in. Parent remains open because .1 stationary regression and .2 calibration/generalization are required remaining work; closure was correctly refused while those children remain open. No claim of uniform preservation of foreground recall.

title: Validate temporal event overlap instead of counting any detection on event windows
description: Modulation study found 100% window-level detection with 0-6% correct repeat recognition under fast modulation; background-only windows also trigger attention. Current evaluator counts any candidate/learned/recognised decision in a foreground-bearing window as event detection, without checking selected region overlap. Add evaluator-only source onset/offset annotations and detector-region telemetry, then measure temporal overlap, false alarms and prototype contamination. Keep all timing truth out of learner decisions.
acceptance_criteria: Fixtures distinguish background-region coincidence from true event localization; continuous filter tails and onset uncertainty defined; re-audit fast modulation plus positive/negative cases; publish corrected detection terminology and metrics without altering historical evidence.
close_reason: Implemented passive detector regions, evaluator-only source intervals and finite room-tail flags; IoU detection and identity scoring with three thresholds, missing-timing policy, tests and audit. Fresh 60-run evaluation archived/audited: 21600 decisions. Paper 03 updated, 47 tests and grader 1.0 pass. Audio/learner parity checks pass. Chance-overlap follow-up filed.

title: Isolate modulation-driven ambience admission before changing memory tolerance
description: Admission diagnostic seeds 700-709: quiet-band admits 13 prototypes across all ten pure-ambience streams, with a false admission in each stream before the halfway background transition. Four confirmations still admit one per stream and sharply reduce foreground recognition. Test matched stationary spectra and independently varied amplitude-modulation depth/rate, noise-floor estimator and gate evidence; include recurring foreground positives so rejecting all input cannot win. Compare fixed quiet-band and any principled baseline without widening memory matching first.
acceptance_criteria: Separate background modulation, spectral shape and channel factors; report affected streams and total false admissions alongside detection/recognition; retain waveform-only interface and exact raw evidence; develop on observed cases then use a fresh frozen evaluation split; update paper with negative results too.
close_reason: Controlled factorial study completed: 25920 development and 86400 fresh evaluation decisions audited; stationary/slow/fast modulation, spectrum/channel factors, three frozen methods and foreground-positive controls. Paper 03 and guide document rejection/recognition tradeoffs and detection-metric limitation. Follow-ups ch-6w4.10.3/.4 created; no detector defaults changed.

title: Diagnose variance memory errors and test admission/matching tradeoffs
description: Run a frozen diagnostic experiment with pure ambience (no events or nuisances), baseline and varied source/joint conditions. Partition repeat failures into detection, pending confirmation, new or duplicate admissions and wrong identities. Compare existing quiet-band policy with four confirmations and broader matching, separately and jointly, on fresh seeds; keep repeat denominator fixed after two ground-truth occurrences. Document results without assuming a successful improvement.
acceptance_criteria: Error partition sums to repeat denominator; pure controls contain no sources; waveform-only learners; paired same audio, fresh seeds and fixed policies; source snapshots, raw decisions and audited bootstrap metrics; manuscript and follow-up tasks updated.
notes: Completed fixed 100-run experiment: five policies, five suites, ten fresh seeds 700-709, -6/0 dB, 120 windows. All 60000 decisions audited. Pure ambience is duplicated across nominal SNR: ten unique streams, not twenty. Quiet-band admits 13 false prototypes across all ten; four confirmations still affect all ten and sharply reduce foreground recognition. Broader matching helps source-only recall but raises wrong identities and does not solve joint variation. Paper section 11, reproduction guide, source snapshots and diagnostic counters added. 34 tests pass; legacy grader 1.0. Follow-up ch-6w4.10.2 created; defaults unchanged.
close_reason: Completed diagnostic partitioning, pure-ambience control, fixed policy comparison, audited raw evidence and manuscript update. Broader robustness task remains open.

title: Stabilize foreground identity across source variation and reject modulated ambience
description: Frozen variance evaluation seeds 600-609 exposes two failures: coupled source pitch/duration changes reduce quiet-band repeat recognition at -6 dB from 73.7% to 37.2%, while joint variance reduces it to 13.5% despite 70.2% detection. Varied backgrounds also cause false memory admissions. Investigate temporal alignment/multiple exemplars and background stationarity or recurrence confidence separately. These seeds are now development evidence, not a sealed future test.
acceptance_criteria: Separate admission, detection and identity errors; evaluate invariance without merging distinct classes or increasing nuisance admissions; new development and frozen evaluation seeds; compare fixed current method; include modulated no-foreground controls.
notes: Earlier variance: seeds 600-609 exposed source/joint identity degradation and false admissions on windows without current sources; tails initially left causality uncertain. 25 Oct diagnostic child ch-6w4.10.1 now completed with seeds 700-709: ten source-free pure ambience streams establish false background admission in every quiet-band run, 13 prototypes total; four confirmations reduce total to 10 but still affect every run. Source-only broader matching improves mean repeat recognition at -6 dB from 32.5% to 39.4%, while wrong repeats rise from 5 to 18 pooled; joint recognition remains poor (7.8% to 7.5%), wrong repeats 49 to 79. Error partitions are now available in paper section 11 and admission-evaluation raw evidence. Defaults unchanged. Follow-up ch-6w4.10.2 isolates modulated background/gate failures before broadening memory. Seeds 600-609 and 700-709 are observed evidence, not sealed future tests.

title: Improve heavily masked and broadband foreground detection
description: The current learner detects only 14.2% of events and correctly recognises 0.6% of repeats at -6 dB. Investigate adaptive thresholds/background estimation and temporal features without retaining extra noise. Explicitly evaluate broadband and sustained events currently rejected by duration/flatness heuristics; retain frozen historical baselines and held-out settings.
acceptance_criteria: Report paired true-event recall and nuisance admissions with uncertainty; demonstrate improvement over archived masked baseline without hiding missed detections or retuning on final evaluation recordings.
notes: 17 Oct: investigate per-band background-relative evidence and time-local features. Keep ForegroundLearner as frozen comparison; develop only on seeds 0-4, reserve 300-309 for evaluation and 400-409 for lower-SNR stress. Add procedural broadband/long events without relabelling recordings; archive iterations, paired seed uncertainty, and write a follow-up research paper.
close_reason: Completed three documented development iterations and a frozen paired procedural evaluation. At -6 dB, repeat recognition improved from 2.0% to 79.5% tonal and 0.3% to 64.0% extended; main evaluation had no selected-method nuisance admissions. Archived exact source snapshots, plan, 72000 audited decisions, per-class results and paired seed intervals; wrote papers/02-masked-foreground-events.md. All 26 tests pass; legacy grader remains 1.0 and installed CLIs work. Long-event, stronger masking and recorded-audio limits preserved in ch-6w4.6, ch-6w4.7, ch-6w4.1 and ch-6w4.3.

title: Build a background-aware acoustic scene and novelty-learning experiment
description: Implement seeded coloured room noise, hum/drift, foreground events, nuisance transients, reverberation and microphone filtering; learn recurring foreground novelty without oracle labels; compare against whole-clip MFCC memory using identical audio and report false admissions, event recall, habituation and reproducible per-seed outputs. Add meaningful regression checks and document limits.
close_reason: Implemented continuous seeded acoustic scenes, mixture-only foreground novelty memory, recurrence ablation and historical MFCC comparator, CLI, docs and archived evidence. Eight tests pass, original grader scores 1.0, installed CLI works, compilation and diff checks pass. Audited 7200 raw decisions against reported per-seed figures/source hashes. Masked/recorded/broadband limitations explicitly preserved and filed for follow-up.

title: Calibrate active-support SNR without cropping full recorded episodes
description: The full5s recorded pilot matches whole-recording current/residual SNR at0/-6dB, but source pauses make1second ratios vary approximately-100 to+13dB at the-6target. This is correctly reported replay calibration, not masked natural-event SNR. Define independently justified active-support masks or use annotated/clean source assets, retain full episodes, and compare whole-episode versus active-support calibration without tuning on held-out waveforms.
acceptance_criteria: Explicit mask/annotation provenance and limitations, preserved5s waveform duration, both full/active measured post-channel ratios, source-disjoint new split, matched no-target/source-deletion controls and episode-aware scoring. No assumption that all energy in a field recording belongs to its labeled event.

title: Audit pending-candidate provenance and admission-time label ambiguity
description: ForegroundLearner keeps the vector from a candidate first sighting, while current evaluator labels the prototype using the window where it is admitted. In mixed streams a foreground-born candidate can be confirmed on a later no-target window, or vice versa; prior physical source tails are also retained. Pure no-target controls remain unambiguous ambient-origin evidence, but mixed-stream no-target admissions do not by themselves prove the stored vector was born from background. Add evaluator-only birth/confirmation provenance without passing truth to actors or changing historical snapshots.
acceptance_criteria: Trace candidate creation/confirmation/admission and stored-vector hashes or identities; compare birth versus admission labels, no-target controls and source-deletion outcomes; quantify any impact on class recall/wrong-identity interpretation; preserve original admission-time scores alongside the new diagnostics; update papers wording where needed.

title: Diagnose rare compensated-background admissions after spectral changes
description: Guarded transition evaluation2400-2409 has one no-target prototype after the spectrum change: spectral_fast/control seed2409 window62. Compensation is already enabled, so the raw-mode uncertainty gate is intentionally inactive and its shadow also detects a candidate. Examine fixed spectral template/background mismatch and compare independently defined adaptive-noise baselines; preserve original source snapshot and avoid tuning on this observed single seed.
acceptance_criteria: Reproduce timing/evidence of the false prototype; develop on explicit observed cases and evaluate a new split with matched positives, source-deletion, source class coverage and stationary controls. No oracle reset or field-robustness claim.

title: Extend recorded catalog with speech, footsteps and sustained alarms
description: The20-clip ESC-10 pilot catalog supplies environmental recordings with verified attribution and source-disjoint folds, but not lexical speech, footsteps or sustained alarms. Find primary-source licensed assets for these categories, multiple source recordings per category and explicit onset/episode scoring scope. FSDD official repository declares CC BY-SA4.0 and may supply short speech; independently verify immutable version, speaker/source disjointness and attribution before ingestion. Do not assume non-ESC10 ESC-50 clips share the subset license.
acceptance_criteria: Pinned clip URLs/checksums and license/provenance records; disjoint development/evaluation source or speaker groups; full-duration alarm examples; no unverified clean-source or onset-annotation claim; cache remains separate from project code license.

title: Integrate pinned recorded clips into continuous calibrated mixtures and episode scoring
description: Use papers/data/esc10-pilot/catalog.json and ignored cached audio to build continuous recorded-source mixtures at0/-6dB post-channel SNR. Preserve full5-second episodes and independent room/mic/background states; treat each recording as an acoustic identity, not semantic category truth. Compare original/quiet/fixed/adaptive/guarded actors through waveform-only access with pure-background and source-removal controls. Coarse clip labels lack onset annotations: define episode-based detection/recurrence scores and do not apply short-event IoU to entire5-second clips or count adjacent windows as independent repeats.
acceptance_criteria: Development/evaluation source groups remain disjoint; pinned catalog/checksum validation; reproducible source/audio/config snapshots; episode-aware repeat scoring with wrong identity and false admission counts; independently auditable SNR and discarded intervention branches; document embedded background/no clean-stem limitation and retain full-duration cases.
notes: Renderer/scorer implemented: full5s clips resampled16k, overlapped recorded backgrounds,42physicalchunks split210actorwindows, prior-episode-only recognition and per-window entire-current-episode deletion. Development2600-2601 usesfold1 only,16800decisions and full audit pass. Untuned evaluation2700-2709/fold5 running. Secondary stricter all-window source exclusion added after development, retains prespecified any-window source-conditioned primary; no learner or audio parameter changes.
close_reason: Implemented full5s recorded replay/recorded-background mixtures at0/-6dB, source-disjoint2600dev/fold1 vs2700eval/fold5, episode-aware pre-episode identity and discarded full-current-episode probes.16,800development/84,000evaluation decisions plus strict exclusion diagnostics audited. Paper07/docs and attributed component snapshots retained;102tests pass/grader1.0. Pure-bg memory failures and active-support/category limitations explicitly tracked; parent remains open.

title: Prepare pinned provenance and source-disjoint splits for recorded audio
description: Prepare a small auditable recorded-audio input catalog using primary dataset repositories: immutable revisions, per-clip attribution and license, original-source IDs, development/evaluation disjointness, and a reproducible cache/download route. Prefer the permissive ESC-10 subset for initial environmental clips and separately identify speech/footstep/alarm coverage gaps. Do not describe cropped patches as natural onset annotations or categorical recurrence as physical identity.
acceptance_criteria: Machine-readable selected-source catalog with pinned URLs and licenses, automated disjoint-source checks, locally verified metadata/audio checksums where downloaded, explicit remaining category/annotation gaps and follow-up ingestion work.
close_reason: Prepared pinned20-clip ESC-10 catalog with exact upstream metadata/license/attribution, original-source-disjoint folds, format/SHA-256/size checks and ignored8.8MB audio cache; downloader/offline audit and provenance tests pass. Ingestion and missing category coverage tracked .1.2/.1.3; parent benchmark remains incomplete.

title: Stress environment adaptation with contaminated startup and overlapping sources
description: The transition benchmark uses six initial target-free windows (silence in silent_fast), fixed source factories and no independent simultaneous masker. Silent-start late gain fitting may encounter ordinary scheduled targets, but forced startup contamination and independent foreground overlap remain uncontrolled. Add independently scheduled background maskers and deliberate target-contaminated initial calibration, preserving current-source-only deletion and post-channel residual SNR.
acceptance_criteria: Independent target/masker scheduling and stems, matched no-target controls, fresh seed split, waveform-only actors and separation of startup/transition/overlap effects; document when source-removal residual contains a different source.

title: Detach embedding memory from caller and sampled-array mutations
description: Verified after atomic-persistence work: add(np.float32_array) retains the caller buffer, so overwriting that array changes stored novelty without learning; sample_pair returns internal arrays that can likewise mutate memory. Make input/sample buffer ownership explicit and safe. This is runtime memory integrity, separate from snapshot serialization.
acceptance_criteria: Mutating input after add or returned sample arrays cannot alter stored embeddings/novelty or eviction history; preserve seeded sampling, FIFO/recency behavior and grader1.0; document copy semantics.
close_reason: EmbeddingStore now owns added vectors and returns copied sample pairs. Input/sampled-buffer mutation fixtures preserve stored novelty, recency eviction and seeded sampling. Documented copy semantics. 75 tests pass and original grader1.0.

title: Add versioned atomic legacy memory persistence with explicit history state
description: ch-btt fixes transactional NPZ loads and rebuilds coherent eviction metadata, but the legacy format saves vectors only and np.savez writes directly to the destination. Add a versioned atomic format that preserves recency clock/timestamps and documents any RNG-resume semantics, while keeping valid positional legacy imports. Keep selective foreground feature-schema isolation.
acceptance_criteria: Interrupted/failed save preserves previous state; versioned round trips retain recency eviction decisions; valid legacy imports retain documented reset behavior; malformed versioned loads are transactional; schema/version and capacity checks; no pickle dependency; original grader passes.
close_reason: Implemented versioned atomic NPZ replacement with fsync, schema/policy/capacity and history validation, exact clock/timestamp restoration, legacy imports and transactional loads. Failure-injection tests preserve prior file and clean temporary files. RNG ownership and capacity behavior documented. 73 tests pass; original grader1.0. Verified live-buffer aliasing bug filed as follow-up.

title: Validate legacy memory snapshots and rebuild eviction state after loading
description: Verified locally: save two embeddings, load into a fresh EmbeddingStore(eviction=recency), then novelty_score raises IndexError because load replaces _items without reconstructing _last_matched. Load also accepts oversized/inconsistent feature archives without validating capacity. Fix transactional validation and coherent FIFO/recency state; preserve historical NPZ reads where valid. This legacy memory schema remains separate from foreground learners.
acceptance_criteria: Round-trip novelty queries/add/eviction work for FIFO and recency; malformed and oversized loads fail without mutating existing state; valid legacy arrays remain readable; documented reset policy for recency history; original grader passes.
close_reason: Fixed loaded recency-query crash by rebuilding timestamps/clock after validated NPZ load. Added transactional capacity/key/dimension/finite-value checks, numeric key ordering, legacy compatibility and empty-store handling; tests cover FIFO/recency eviction and invalid-load nonmutation. Python README documents reset policy. 53 tests pass, original grader 1.0; atomic/versioned persistence tracked as ch-f5q.

title: Calibrate post-channel SNR and separate pitch from duration stressors
description: Variance study matches active SNR before room/microphone filtering; spectral shaping can alter effective masking. Add separately filtered foreground/background stems with persistent tails for evaluator-only post-channel SNR measurement. Separate pitch shifts from time stretches rather than coupled resampling, and report class identity ambiguity under large transforms. Preserve waveform-only learner interface.
acceptance_criteria: Analytic linear-channel fixtures validate stem recombination and SNR; compare matched pre/post-channel conditions; independent pitch/time factors with duration bounds; archive fresh seed results.
notes: Overlap controls task ch-6w4.10.5 exposes trajectory-history confounding in pure-background versus foreground comparisons. Separated linear-channel stems should support foreground-present/removed probes from identical copied learner state, retaining previous-source tails; distinguish this instantaneous intervention from all-background trajectory comparisons.
close_reason: Implemented optional continuous component stems and current-source removal, exact active post-residual calibration, independent pitch/time factors, same-prior-state discarded learner probes, examples and audits. Fresh90-stream/32400-decision evaluation and paired condition contrasts archived. Paper05 and guide document SNR shifts and identity limits; 67 tests pass, grader1.0. Pitch-invariant matching follow-up filed; startup/overlap remains ch-6w4.10.4.2.

title: Evaluate independently varied procedural sources and acoustics
description: Increase procedural variability with independent environment and source seeds, factorized room/microphone/background/source conditions and joint variation. Keep existing detectors frozen and evaluate fresh paired seeds with nuisance-only controls. Archive parameters, decisions, source hashes and uncertainty; update paper with failures as well as gains.
acceptance_criteria: Deterministic finite streaming audio; environment changes preserve event schedule; bounds and window fit tested; fresh seed evaluation and raw-decision audit; per-condition and nuisance results documented.
notes: Completed 140 paired streams, fresh seeds 600-609, 120 windows each, -6/0 dB, six factorized conditions plus joint no-foreground controls. 33600 decisions and source snapshots audited; 30 tests pass, legacy grader 1.0. Follow-ups ch-6w4.9 and ch-6w4.10 created.

title: Compare masked-event frontend with PCEN and adaptive noise estimation baselines
description: The new paper is an engineering comparison against the original selective learner, not an empirical comparison with established PCEN or MCRA estimators. Add direct, carefully configured published-method baselines on the recorded benchmark ch-6w4.1, with the same discovery memory budget and held-out source recordings. Keep noise normalization for detection separate from stored-feature normalization.
acceptance_criteria: Document implementations and tuning budgets; evaluate event recall, correct repeat recognition, nuisance admissions and runtime on held-out recordings; compare before drawing broader robustness or efficiency claims.
notes:
25 Oct gain study adds shared spectral gain, not PCEN. Compare on recordings with matched memory and separate gate/feature normalization. Official librosa 0.11 PCEN docs require deliberate magnitude/input scaling for publication defaults and persistent zi/zf in streaming; do not apply default PCEN blindly to small normalized power matrices. Primary Wang2017 paper and implementation docs are linked in paper04.
Recorded pilot now available: source-disjoint ESC10 fold1/fold5, full5s replay episodes,0/-6dB post-current-recording/residual, continuous recorded backgrounds and same-state episode-removal probes. Untuned gain frontend improves strict episode exclusion38% vsquiet16% on unmodulated-6, but pure-bg attention47.7%,68 no-target prototypes across10 streams; modulated49.3%,74. This makes direct published PCEN/adaptive noise baselines actionable without waiting for missing speech/footstep/alarm assets. Preserve fixed recordings/seed correlation and source-embedded background caveats.
Primary-source preparation: installedlibrosa0.11.0 pcen and official0.11docs verified. Default input is magnitude; publication defaults assume40mel bands,25ms/10ms and audio scaled to2**31, not normalized-1..1. Preserve zi/zf across processed frames, and document existing clip-boundary STFT schedule rather than claiming a fully continuous sample frontend. MCRA primary source:Cohen/Berdugo2002,SPL9(1),12-15,doi10.1109/97.988717,author PDF https://webee.technion.ac.il/Sites/People/IsraelCohen/Publications/SPL_Jan2002.pdf ; distinguish from IMCRA2003. Need explicit tuning budget and fresh source files because fold5 pilot recordings are now observed.

title: Improve sustained foreground tracking when quiet frames are scarce
description: The masked-event study improves extended-inventory recognition to 64.0% at -6 dB but long_alarm still reaches only 45.6% detection and 16.1% repeat recognition. Investigate cross-window segmentation and background updates when an event fills most/all of a window, without turning stationary hum/fans into foreground. Use fresh development/evaluation splits; seeds 300-409 are now observed evidence.
acceptance_criteria: Separate sustained-event detection from prototype instability; include boundary-crossing/continuous events, stationary-background controls, and nuisance admission counts. Report paired seed uncertainty and retain the archived quiet-band comparison.

title: Measure selective capture gaps and learning-cue self-echo on hardware
description: Follow up selective capture/controller integration ch-6w4.4. The new microphone path uses blocking one-second captures, computation between windows, and a 250 ms discarded guard after optional fixed learning cues. Tests mock devices and prove routing/protocol rules; actual capture gaps, room echo beyond the guard, and missed foreground events are not yet measured. Quantify these with a real microphone/speaker and MCU; compare continuous buffered capture and echo-aware suppression while preserving waveform-only external-event learning.
acceptance_criteria: Measure capture duty cycle and end-to-end display latency, count events missed during processing/playback/guard, and test self-cue false candidates/admissions in multiple rooms. Document device settings and whether a continuous stream or echo canceller is needed.

title: Integrate selective listening with capture and mood without mixing feature schemas
description: ForegroundLearner is currently a separate perception experiment. Add an opt-in capture/controller path so candidate, learned and recognised outcomes drive appropriate displays and avoid automatic background replay. Keep its 96-D temporal context separate from legacy 13-D MFCC voice exemplars; define persistence and restart behaviour before combining either memory with dream/repertoire operations.
acceptance_criteria: Exercise a capture replay through controller transitions, including calibration and silence; prevent incompatible feature comparisons; verify no background-triggered vocal response; preserve legacy demo and grader behaviour.
close_reason: Implemented opt-in chuff-selective microphone/WAV controller, mood/serial routing and silent-by-default fixed learning notification; versioned atomic foreground-memory persistence with schema/dimension validation and explicit restart recalibration. All 19 tests pass with mocked hardware, legacy grader remains 1.0, compilation passes, installed CLI replays 120-window scene and recognises restored memories without new admissions. Hardware timing/echo measurement recorded separately.

title: Compare recurrence with learning-progress and one-off importance policies
description: Separate learnable novelty from stochastic unpredictability and human relevance. Compare current two-sighting confirmation with uncertainty or learning-progress admission, habituation to repeating nuisances, and a bounded short-term response to important one-off events. Use equal memory budgets and an explicit experimental definition or supplied feedback for importance rather than assuming tonality equals value.
acceptance_criteria: Evaluate recurring useful events, recurring nuisance, random distractors and one-off foregrounds; report immediate responses separately from permanent memory, repeat recognition and false admissions. Document any supervised feedback and keep it out of mixture-only baselines.
notes: 17 Oct masked study: selected quiet-band method admitted no nuisance memories in main evaluation, but stress runs at -9/-12 dB admitted five distractor patterns across tonal/nuisance-only streams. No audited admissions occurred on ambience-only windows. Use these as observed failure cases for admission-policy design, not sealed evaluation. Evidence: papers/02-masked-foreground-events.md and papers/results/masked-events/stress.

title: Build a held-out recorded foreground and background benchmark
description: Add owned or appropriately licensed recordings with provenance and disjoint source recordings for development versus evaluation. Include speech, footsteps, long alarms and overlapping sources, varied backgrounds, independent room/microphone conditions and calibrated SNR mixtures. Maintain waveform-only learner access, reproducible manifests and raw per-window outcomes.
acceptance_criteria: Document licenses and splits; include at least tonal, broadband and long-duration foreground cases; provide paired baseline runs with per-seed recall, wrong recognition and nuisance admissions at 0 dB and below.
notes:
17 Oct: compare both original frontend and new quiet-band configuration on recorded mixtures. Current evidence remains procedural; seeds 300-409 have been inspected. The exact methods and per-window evidence are archived with source snapshots in papers/results/masked-events.
New experimental spectral-gain frontend and separate schema are available for the recorded benchmark, alongside original and quiet-band. Paper04 shows modulation recovery with stationary regression; include stationary/modulated backgrounds and imperfect warmup in recorded comparisons. Seeds 1200-1209 are now observed procedural evidence.
Prepared20 verified ESC-10 clips:10development fold1/10evaluation fold5, original Freesound IDs disjoint, exact upstream licenses/attributions and immutable SHA pinned, 8.8MB ignored cache. This is input preparation only; episode-aware mixture/scoring and speech/footstep/alarm coverage are child .2/.3. Full parent acceptance remains unmet.
Child .2 full-duration recorded pilot complete; paper07. At recorded-6, gain primary43%/strict38% vs quiet17%/16%; however gain pure-bg attention47.7% and68 prototypes across10 controls, so no robust recorded foreground discovery claim.0/-6 refer whole5s injection:window ratios can-100..+13. Remaining coverage .3 and active-support calibration .4; published comparison .7 now actionable.

title: Evaluate recorded and heavily masked foreground sounds beyond tonal novelty

Build licensed/owned recorded foreground-background mixtures including speech, footsteps, long alarms and overlapping sources; vary rooms and microphones independently; compare recurrence admission with learning-progress or importance signals so broadband and important one-off events are not filtered out. Preserve waveform-only learner access, per-seed false-admission and true-event-recall metrics, raw traces, and held-out recordings. Evidence: papers/01-foreground-novelty.md and papers/results/foreground-novelty.
acceptance_criteria: Child tasks provide a held-out recorded-audio benchmark, improved masked/broadband detection, an evaluated importance/admission policy, and a schema-safe capture/mood integration. Preserve the existing main/stress evidence and report both true-event recall and nuisance admission rates.

title: Test replacing Repertoire's index-based default tie-break with a random one
description: ch-63 ruled out the relevance gate as the cause of coarse (2-of-6) grounding in grounding_demo.py, via a clean 4-threshold x 10-seed sweep with zero effect even at threshold=0.9. The real suspect is Repertoire._base_default(call_index) = 0.5 - 0.001*call_index: a fixed index-order ramp means call#0 wins any brand-new context by default whenever no call has a qualifying exemplar yet, regardless of relevance-gate strictness. Test: replace the index ramp with a per-instance random tie-break fixed at construction (deterministic across repeated closest_call() calls, just not correlated with index) and re-run grounding_demo.py's 10-seed sweep - does distinct-pairs count rise above ~2/6 once the structural index bias is removed?

title: Tighten Repertoire's relevance gate to test finer-grained grounding
description: Hypothesis REFUTED, cleanly. Moved RELEVANCE_SIM_THRESHOLD/SAME_CONTEXT_DISTANCE into config.py (were hardcoded in comms.py, violating the project's own convention) and exposed as optional Repertoire constructor overrides (backward compatible, eval grader still scores 1.0). Swept 0.3/0.5/0.7/0.9 across 10 seeds each via grounding_demo.py --sweep-thresholds: avg distinct pairs stayed ~2.0/6 at EVERY threshold including 0.9 (near-impossible to clear). No effect at all. Real mechanism must be _base_default()'s index-based tie-break, not the relevance gate - even a near-unreachable gate still leaves call#0 winning any new context by default when nothing else has a qualifying exemplar either. Correctly-targeted follow-up: ch-64.

title: Heed clebran's 'transport not discovery' finding for the two-unit comms track
description: clebran-arc-agi's headline, hard-won result: at matched compute, a single learner mining its own solution library (B5) beats every multi-agent gossip arm (B2/B3/B6/B7/B8/B9), across many control conditions - 'communication is a transport mechanism, not a discovery mechanism' in that domain. Caution for ch-23a/ch-23b: don't expect two-unit comms to make either Chuff learn calls faster/better than a single well-tuned Chuff would alone. The two-unit track's actual value is probably the convention-formation/signaling phenomenon itself (does a stable shared mapping emerge at all - Theme 3.3's grounding question), not a learning-speed win - which is consistent with what two_unit_demo.py already showed (contingent ack produces a stable convention, not obviously a *better* one). Decision: keep the two-unit track framed as a signaling/convention-formation question, not a skill-transfer question, when writing it up.

title: Stitch-style library mining over evolved CallPrograms
description: The B5 central-library result (clebran-arc-agi) says a single learner mining its own solutions into a reusable abstraction library beats multi-agent sharing at matched compute. Port the idea: after evolving CallPrograms toward several different targets (ch-60), mine recurring op-sequences across the best-of-run programs into reusable 'motifs' (clebran's dsl/abstraction.py antiunification algorithm is the reference design). Blocked in practice, not formally: ch-60 found the MFCC-cosine fitness metric accepts structural shortcuts (chirp-as-tone, tone-with-AM-as-chirp) that would bias what gets mined toward 'things that fool cosine similarity' rather than meaningful acoustic building blocks - needs a stricter or multi-target fitness before mining is worth running.

title: Compositional call-construction DSL + evolutionary search (call_dsl.py)
description: Inspired by clebran-arc-agi's linear-IR genome (mutation/crossover/fragment vocabulary) applied to Chuff's much simpler acoustic domain: a CallProgram is one generator op (tone/chirp) plus 0-3 modifier ops (am, envelope), with mutate_const/swap/grow/delete and crossover. dsl_evolution_demo.py (chuff-sim-dsl) evolves a population toward a target sound's MFCC via cosine-similarity fitness. Both a tone target and a wide-chirp target reach ~0.97-0.98 fitness, but via structural shortcuts (a near-zero-width chirp for the tone target; an AM-heavy tone for the chirp target), not the 'intended' generator - see shared/research_backlog.md for the full writeup and why that matters for ch-61.

title: Compare A's and B's independently-converged call-to-sound mappings
description: grounding_demo.py (chuff-sim-grounding): Unit B upgraded to a full second ChuffAgent, both units hear+speak+ack symmetrically. A 10-seed sweep (seeds 0-9, 150 rounds each) - the first 3 runs looked like a fixed acoustic split and that write-up was wrong, corrected after sweeping more seeds - shows: always exactly 2 distinct (A-call,B-call) pairs, always 100% purity per label every seed, and the majority pair is ALWAYS call #0/#0 (Repertoire's untrained index-0 tie-break has a real structural edge). But WHICH 1-2 labels break away from that majority varies by seed (kettle_whistle+bird_call in 3/10, car_horn+dog_bark in 4/10, phone_ring alone in 3/10) with no consistent acoustic theme. Reading: coarse-but-real discrimination driven by presentation-order lock-in (whichever label first falls outside call#0's relevance-gate radius claims a different call and keeps it), not a fixed acoustic category boundary. See shared/research_backlog.md Theme 3.3. Follow-up (tighter relevance gate / remove index bias) tracked as ch-63.

title: Babbling warm-up phase in sim/run_demo.py

Clean positive result, held up across seed counts. See shared/research_backlog.md Theme 1.1.

title: JSONL call-context/acknowledgement logging
description: All three sim demos (run_demo.py, two_unit_demo.py, grounding_demo.py) were reimplementing JSONL logging ad hoc instead of using the already-implemented comms.log_event() - refactored all three to use it. Doing so surfaced a real latent bug that had existed since two_unit_demo.py was first written: _detect_tone() returns numpy.bool_ (via comparisons on numpy FFT-array scalars), which json.dumps rejects - '--log' had never actually been exercised in testing before, so the crash was never caught. Fixed by explicitly casting to Python float/bool in _detect_tone(). Verified: all three demos now log every round correctly (line count matches round count) and the crash is gone.
